examples.name: two_clauses
examples.note: Each clause has its own entity variable. Both clauses must hold.
examples.text: The aircraft is gray and the school buses are yellow.
examples.logical_form: (EXISTS X1: ((entity(X1, aircraft) AND attribute(X1, gray))) AND EXISTS X2: ((entity(X2, school_bus) AND attribute(X2, yellow))))

examples.name: active
examples.note: The subject is the agent; the object is the theme (the participant receiving the action).
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1, X2: ((entity(X1, alice) AND entity(X2, bob) AND EXISTS E1: ((event(E1, hug) AND hug(E1, X1, X2)))))

examples.name: passive
examples.note: The passive subject is the theme; the by-phrase supplies the agent. Variable numbers follow noun processing order, so compare roles rather than X1 alone.
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1, X2: ((entity(X1, bob) AND entity(X2, alice) AND EXISTS E1: ((event(E1, hug) AND hug(E1, X2, X1)))))

examples.name: negation
examples.note: NOT surrounds the entire event search. It does not mean that one nonmatching event is enough to support the negative claim.
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1, X2: ((entity(X1, alice) AND entity(X2, bob) AND NOT (EXISTS E1: ((event(E1, hug) AND hug(E1, X1, X2))))))

examples.name: property_negation
examples.note: The aircraft must be present; only its yellow attribute is negated.
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1: ((entity(X1, aircraft) AND NOT (attribute(X1, yellow))))

examples.name: possessive
examples.note: Possession is a separate relation between owner and possession. The white attribute belongs to the shirt.
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1: ((EXISTS X2: ((entity(X1, shirt) AND entity(X2, woman) AND possess(X2, X1))) AND attribute(X1, white)))

examples.name: branch_scope
examples.note: Each OR branch binds its own participants. A supported Alice/Bob branch does not require any Carol candidate.
examples.input_origin: hand-specified UD example; compiler demonstration only
examples.text: Alice hugs Bob or Carol runs.
examples.logical_form: (EXISTS X1, X2: ((entity(X1, alice) AND entity(X2, bob) AND EXISTS E1: ((event(E1, hug) AND hug(E1, X1, X2))))) OR EXISTS X3: ((entity(X3, carol) AND EXISTS E2: ((event(E2, run) AND run(E2, X3))))))

examples.name: shared_reference
examples.note: Repeated proper name Alice reuses X1 across both clauses; the two actions still have different event variables.
examples.input_origin: hand-specified UD example; compiler demonstration only
examples.text: Alice hugs Bob and Alice runs.
examples.logical_form: EXISTS X1: ((EXISTS X2: ((entity(X1, alice) AND entity(X2, bob) AND EXISTS E1: ((event(E1, hug) AND hug(E1, X1, X2))))) AND (entity(X1, alice) AND EXISTS E2: ((event(E2, run) AND run(E2, X1))))))
